{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Heart of Flesh''''' was a [[Qektoth attack cruiser]] that served the [[Qektoth Confederation]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The vessel carried five [[Qektoth Confederation starfighter]]s, and was armed with [[Plasma cannon (Qektoth Confederation)|plasma cannons]] and a [[bio-energy array]]. In 8 ABY, the ''Heart of Flesh'' [[Battle of Yvara|engaged]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' over the planet [[Yvara]].
